candidates.rules_primary: If Each Yes contract pays $0.05 per reception recorded by Cam Skattebo during the Washington vs New York G Pro Football game originally scheduled for Nov 12, 2026. This is a scalar market. The Yes payout per contract is $0.05 per reception constrained between $0.00–$1.00 with a cap at 20 receptions. The No payout is $1.00 minus the Yes payout. For example, 8 receptions pays Yes $0.40 and No $0.60; 11 receptions pays Yes $0.55 and No $0.45; zero receptions pay Yes $0.00 and No $1.00.
